Notes.Text:
This update for apache2 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-42356: deployment of wrong handler allows target of internal redirects from CGI programs to also be treated
  as CGI and executed (bsc#1284043).
- CVE-2026-42528: memory calculation bug in `mod_dav` allows an attacker with permission to create WebDAV locks to crash
  server child processes (bsc#1284044).
- CVE-2026-46729: NULL pointer dereference in `mod_heartmonitor` over unicast listener (bsc#1284045).
- CVE-2026-47360: session cookie passed to a backend server when `SessionCookieRemove` changes across internal redirects
  (bsc#1284046).
- CVE-2026-48005: missing authentication checks in `mod_auth_digest` allows an unauthenticated remote client to cause a
  DoS via forged `Authorization` headers when Digest authentication is enabled with `AuthDigestNcCheck` (bsc#1284047).
- CVE-2026-56153: out-of-bounds write in `mod_charset_lite` (bsc#1284048).
- CVE-2026-56154: use-after-free in `mod_rewrite` when using lookahead `(%{LA-U:HTTP:...})` (bsc#1284049).
- CVE-2026-57941: use-after-free in `mod_http2` via shared `session->bbtmp` re-entrancy (bsc#1284050).
- CVE-2026-58415: internal state files accessible to external parties in `mod_dav_fs` allows a remote client to read
  WebDAV dead properties of resources it cannot author via a GET request for the .DAV state directory (bsc#1284051).
- CVE-2026-59797: improper privilege management in `mod_ssl` when using `SSLRequire` and file-related expressions
  (bsc#1284059).
- CVE-2026-63045: improper validation of FTP PASV reply address in `mod_proxy_ftp` allows an untrusted FTP server to
  cause a proxy to open a data connection to an arbitrary third-party host (bsc#1284060).
- CVE-2026-63292: stack-based buffer overflow in `mod_vhost_alias` allows a remote client to cause a DoS or potentially
  execute arbitrary code via an HTTP request with a specially crafted `Host` header (bsc#1284061).
- CVE-2026-63686: NULL pointer dereference in `mod_xml2enc` allows an untrusted backend server to cause a denial of
  service via a crafted proxied response (bsc#1284058).
- CVE-2026-63718: inconsistent interpretation of HTTP requests in `mod_proxy_uwsgi` allows for response smuggling via a
  crafted uwsgi response with `Transfer-Encoding` (bsc#1284057).
- CVE-2026-73636: authentication bypass by capture-replay in `mod_auth_digest` allows a MiTM attacker to replay captured
  digest authentication credentials via crafted requests (bsc#1284056).
- CVE-2026-73637: use-after-free in `mod_auth_digest` allows an unauthenticated remote client to cause authentication
  state corruption via concurrent Digest authentication requests (bsc#1284055).
- CVE-2026-79768: path equivalence issue in the `mod_userdir` module when configured with absolute non-wildcard
  `UserDir` directive (bsc#1284054).
- CVE-2026-93546: integer overflow in `mod_dav_fs` allows an authenticated WebDAV client with write access to crash
  worker processes and persistently corrupt a directory's property database (bsc#1284053).

Vulnerabilities.Description:
Use after free in mod_auth_digest in Apache Software Foundation Apache HTTP Server before 2.4.69 on all platforms allows an unauthenticated remote client to cause authentication state corruption via concurrent Digest authentication requests when AuthDigestNcCheck is enabled or AuthDigestNonceLifetime is set to 0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.69, which fixes this issue.
